kizkalesi.name: Maiden's Castle
kizkalesi.slogan: A castle afloat just offshore, with a snake in its legend.
kizkalesi.line: Re-fortified in the early 12th century on the orders of Alexios I Komnenos, it once joined the shore by a breakwater.

uzuncaburc.name: Uzuncaburç
uzuncaburc.slogan: A mountain city of priest-kings, still guarded by its tall tower.
uzuncaburc.line: The Hellenistic tower that gave the village its name was built in the second half of the 3rd century BCE.

cleopatragate.name: Cleopatra's Gate
cleopatragate.slogan: The last gate of Tarsus, where a queen came to meet Antony.
cleopatragate.line: The barge she sat in, like a burnish'd throne, / Burn'd on the water.
cleopatragate.by: William Shakespeare, Antony and Cleopatra, on her arrival at Tarsus

yumuktepe.name: Yumuktepe Mound
yumuktepe.slogan: A whole city's past, stacked layer by layer inside Mersin.
yumuktepe.line: John Garstang first dug here in 1936-38; war halted him, and some records were lost in a Liverpool air raid.

soli.name: Soli Pompeiopolis
soli.slogan: Roman columns marching toward the sea on a pirate-built street.
soli.line: Under the lex Gabinia of 67 BCE, Pompey resettled surrendered pirates in Soli and renamed it Pompeiopolis.
